props.name: options
props.description: The choices to show, each with a value, label and optional disabled flag.

props.name: value
props.description: Selected option value. Set it to control the component.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Option selected at first when uncontrolled. Defaults to the first enabled option.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the new option value whenever the choice changes.

props.name: size
props.description: Control height and text size: "sm", "md" or "lg".

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Stretch to the full width and share it equally.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Required: names the group for screen readers.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes added to the outer element.
